portraits.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. EDIT the provided multiplayer browser mockup into the JOINED ROOM state for the same indie robot arena game PROTOTYPE 0. Preserve exactly its coherent UI art style, framing, lighting, background, readable fonts, cream/orange/cyan/charcoal palette. Render one complete straight-on 16:9 landscape high-definition game screenshot, image-only proposal.

Keep the same centered charcoal angular industrial plate, subtly textured steel, small orange corner hardware, cyan short light accents, warm softly blurred low-poly sandy scrapyard background. This state replaces the creation form and room list with a simple elegant duel room. It must visibly belong to exactly the same UI set as the input.
Header: small wordmark "PROTOTYPE 0" at top left. Large page title "SALON DE ROMAIN". A small cyan status dot with "EN LIGNE" at top right. Under the title, small "DUEL 1 CONTRE 1". No technical text.
The content consists of two matching balanced wide player slots, side by side, with understated "VS" between them. Each slot is a graphite inset panel with angled corners and generous breathing room. Use the same small angular robot helmet emblems already visible in the reference, enlarged as stylized portraits with very restrained dimensionality: cyan robot helmet for left player, orange robot helmet for right. Do not invent new detailed humanoid robot models or player customization controls. Left slot: small muted role tag "HÔTE" at top; helmet emblem in middle; strong cream player label "Vous" below; small cyan status dot and "CONNECTÉ". Right slot: role tag "INVITÉ"; orange robot helmet emblem in middle; cream player label "Adversaire"; cyan dot and "CONNECTÉ". Both participants are connected, so the host can launch. No readiness system.
Below slots, short centered "2 / 2 JOUEURS" in cyan, with breathing room.
Footer separated by a subtle divider: compact industrial graphite secondary button "QUITTER LE SALON" at left; a muted small "L’hôte lance le duel." near center; strong but proportionate orange primary button "LANCER LE MATCH" at right. No huge full-width CTA. Footer and title are completely inside the plate.
Exact visible text: "PROTOTYPE 0", "SALON DE ROMAIN", "DUEL 1 CONTRE 1", "EN LIGNE", "HÔTE", "Vous", "CONNECTÉ", "VS", "INVITÉ", "Adversaire", "CONNECTÉ", "2 / 2 JOUEURS", "QUITTER LE SALON", "L’hôte lance le duel.", "LANCER LE MATCH".
Make it feel focused on an immediate 1v1 robot duel with polished layout and readable clear hierarchy. Preserve excellent French accents. This represents existing connected-player and host-launch behavior. Do not invent ready buttons, ranks, stats, maps, room passwords, room codes, invitation features, chat, ping, weapons or loadout editing controls, tiny illegible descriptions, tutorials or decoration paragraphs. No gold, fantasy ornament, excessive neon, watermarks or browser frame.
